values.value: Finds: Active approval rules (sbaa__ApprovalRule__c or SBQQ__ApprovalRule__c) that have existed for more than 90 days but have zero corresponding Approval records (sbaa__Approval__c / SBQQ__Approval__c) created in the last 90 days. Why it matters: A rule that looks healthy (active, has approver, has conditions) but never fires is the deal-desk-dead pattern — the gate is on paper but not in practice. Either the rule conditions never match real quotes, another rule earlier in evaluation order short-circuits it, or the approval matrix routes around it. Operators believe they have governance they don't. Suppress a finding: when the rule is intentionally dormant (legacy product line wound down, regulatory rule waiting on a hire). Disable the detector: only if your org runs approval rules outside the standard sbaa/SBQQ flow.
Audit {N} approval rules that haven't fired in 90+ days
